brief:
Israel has killed record numbers of journalists and spent more than $1 billion on influence campaigns aimed at shaping global public opinion, Middle East Eye reported. Despite the scale of the effort, the outlet noted that international perception has not shifted decisively in Israel's favor.

The spending and casualties represent what some observers characterize as an intensified struggle over information and narrative control, occurring alongside conventional military operations.

title: Israel's billion-dollar campaign to control narrative falters despite journalist deaths
